Definition: the fat; abstractly fatness, i.e. (figuratively) abundance; specifically the (fatty) ashes of sacrifices
BiblicalUsage: Fatness is richness and abundance, and it is also the fatty ashes left from the sacrifices on the altar. The priest carries the ashes outside the camp, the soul of the hungry is satisfied as with marrow and fatness, and God invites the thirsty to eat what is good and delight in fatness.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe fatness is the Bible's word for a life filled past the brim. God does not feed His people sparingly; His table is rich, His mercy is abundant, and the ashes of the altar are the proof that the cost was paid.
